name: Nagybaracska (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagybaracska: a crowned blue shield with a figure, a fish and a white bird, with red and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed NAGYBARACSKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagybaracska arms with crown, mantling and scroll
